name: count
query: * | select count(*) as c

name: count-implicit-alias
query: * | select count(*) c

name: count-noalias
query: * | select count(*)

name: count-distinct
query: * | select count(distinct trace_id) as t, count(latency_ms) as n, count(1) as one

name: agg-long
query: * | select sum(latency_ms) as s, avg(latency_ms) as a, min(latency_ms) as mi, max(latency_ms) as ma

name: agg-double
query: * | select sum(ratio) as s, avg(ratio) as a, min(amount) as mi, max(elapsed_ms) as ma

name: group
query: * | select level, count(*) as c group by level order by c desc

name: group-implicit
query: * | select level, count(*) c group by level order by c desc

name: group-2
query: * | select service, level, count(*) as c group by service, level order by service, level

name: group-ordinal
query: * | select service, count(*) as c group by 1 order by 1

name: having
query: * | select level, count(*) as c group by level having count(*) > 50 order by level

name: where
query: * | select count(*) as c where latency_ms > 300

name: from-log-where
query: * | select count(1) as c from log where level = 'ERROR'

name: search-and-sql
query: level: ERROR | select service, count(*) as c group by service order by service

name: search-and-sql2
query: service: checkout and latency_ms > 100 | select count(*) as c

name: like
query: * | select count(*) as c from log where msg like '%order%'

name: in
query: * | select count(*) as c from log where level in ('ERROR', 'WARN')

name: between
query: * | select count(*) as c from log where latency_ms between 100 and 200

name: is-null
query: * | select count(*) as c from log where order_id is null

name: is-not-null
query: * | select count(*) as c from log where ctx is not null

name: order-limit
query: * | select msg, latency_ms where latency_ms > 1000 order by latency_ms desc, msg limit 3

name: limit-default
query: * | select msg

name: limit-big
query: * | select level, count(*) as c group by level order by level limit 100000

name: limit-offset
query: * | select level from log group by level order by level limit 1 offset 1

name: distinct
query: * | select distinct service order by service

name: select-quoted
query: * | select "level", "__time__" order by __time__ limit 1

name: select-meta
query: * | select __topic__, __source__, __time__ order by __time__ limit 2

name: select-tag
query: * | select "__tag__:__path__" limit 1

name: select-alias-index
query: * | select svc, count(*) as c group by svc order by svc

name: select-json-sub
query: * | select "ctx.user.tier" as tier, count(*) as c where "ctx.user.tier" is not null group by tier order by tier

name: select-json-sub-long
query: * | select max("ctx.user.id") as m

name: select-nodocvalue
query: * | select url limit 1

name: select-unindexed
query: * | select method limit 1

name: select-unknown
query: * | select nonexist limit 1

name: other-logstore
query: * | select count(*) as c from other

name: qualified
query: * | select log.level from log limit 1

name: subquery
query: * | select level, c from (select level, count(*) as c from log group by level) where c > 10 order by level

name: subquery-sum
query: * | select sum(c) as s from (select count(*) as c from log group by level)

name: subquery-implicit
query: * | select sum(c) from (select count(*) c from log group by level)

name: cte
query: * | with t as (select level, count(*) as c from log group by level) select level, c from t order by level

name: union
query: * | select level from log where level = 'ERROR' union all select level from log where level = 'WARN' limit 2

name: window-rownum
query: * | select level, row_number() over (order by level) as rn from (select distinct level from log) order by level

name: window-rank
query: * | select level, c, rank() over (order by c desc) as r, lag(c) over (order by level) as l, sum(c) over () as t from (select level, count(*) as c from log group by level) order by level

name: window-pct
query: * | select level, count(*) as c, count(*) * 100.0 / sum(count(*)) over () as pct group by level order by level

name: multiply
query: * | select latency_ms * 2 as x, latency_ms * 1.5 as y, latency_ms / 7 as z order by __time__, msg limit 3

name: arith-agg
query: * | select sum(latency_ms) * 1.0 / count(latency_ms) as a

name: filter-clause
query: * | select count(*) filter (where latency_ms > 300) as f

name: set-session
query: * | set session parallel_sql=true; select count(*) as c

name: case
query: * | select case when latency_ms > 300 then 'slow' when latency_ms > 100 then 'mid' else 'fast' end as k, count(*) as c where latency_ms is not null group by k order by k

name: if
query: * | select if(latency_ms > 300, 'slow', 'fast') as k, count(*) as c group by k order by k

name: coalesce
query: * | select coalesce(order_id, 'none') as o, count(*) as c group by o order by c desc, o limit 3

name: cast-text
query: * | select sum(cast(user_id as bigint)) as s

name: try-cast
query: * | select count(try_cast(msg as bigint)) as c

name: bigint-vs-string
query: * | select count(*) as c where latency_ms > '100'

name: divide-zero
query: * | select 1/0 as x

name: cast-fail
query: * | select cast('a' as bigint) as x

name: time-bucket
query: * | select __time__ - __time__ % 60 as t, count(*) as c group by t order by t limit 5

name: timegroup-plugin
query: * | select __time__ - __time__ % 30 as time, level, count(*) as count group by time, level order by time limit 6

name: max-time
query: * | select max(__time__) - min(__time__) as span

name: concat-pipes
query: * | select level || '/' || service as p order by __time__, msg limit 1
